subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface reactions, edits, deletes, read receipts, and similar non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: The current source has partial primitives but no documented external-channel contract, and the open `inbound_activity` PR overlaps only one possible API direction while changing public Plugin SDK behavior.

options.title: Document Existing System Events First
options.body: Treat reaction/edit/read-receipt notifications as routed system events where possible, document the external plugin recipe, and add new API only for proven gaps.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Hook
options.body: Define a typed Plugin SDK hook or adapter for non-message channel activity and align it with the related open `inbound_activity` work before merging implementation PRs.

options.title: Defer For Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why existing system events and `runtime.channel.inbound.run` cannot satisfy the use case.

recommendation.title: Document Existing System Events First
recommendation.body: Treat reaction/edit/read-receipt notifications as routed system events where possible, document the external plugin recipe, and add new API only for proven gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent live path history and the prior channel inbound refactor make this the strongest available owner signal for the Plugin SDK direction choice.
